findings.summary: The committed implement handoff records work_head_commit as 641bd6a5ab43584a8a5b11310e4784aeb1bed05a, while the attempt context supplied to this review names the product commit (work_head_commit) as 3604df1dd9702123208f9395fd3142ee0c3ec76d. This is consistent with the materializer stacking a metadata-only commit on the actor's product commit, but the two records use the same field name for different SHAs, and the same disagreement was raised on attempt 1 and not reconciled.

test_all_thirteen_tools_are_reachable and the docstring at line 155 ('partitions the 13 names') are stale: ALL_TOOLS holds 15 entries after development_adopt and development_recover were added. The assertions themselves are correct and non-vacuous; only the names mislead a reader of the file that pins the MCP surface.

B2 adoption is automatic and idempotent once a discovery arrives, but nothing in src/ discovers: DdControlPlane.adopt takes the discovery batch from its caller, and development_adopt is the only entry point. The spec's trigger ('when eligible work is discovered') is therefore satisfied by the caller, not by an in-repo scanner; the discovery-then-adopt split and its idempotency, which is what the spec and B3's mandated test list actually require, are implemented and tested.

B1-B3-SPEC.md at the repository root duplicates the digest-bound .dev-dispatch/spec/approved.md byte-for-byte. It was raised on attempt 1 and still stands; the frozen copy under .dev-dispatch/ is the single source, and the root duplicate invites divergence.

Two mechanical checks were not executed, because this reviewer role has file-inspection tools only and shell access was declined: the mandated product-consistency diff between 3604df1d and c37cb9b0 excluding .dev-dispatch, and the spec's acceptance commands (uv sync --frozen, make verify). No claim is made about either; the handoff's verification_record attests exit_code 0 for both commands, and the review was conducted against the worktree contents at /data/worktrees/fleet-graph-b1-b3-20260828. No finding is raised on this basis.
